resources.string: Lets you send what\'s on your screen by touching the top of your phone\'s screen to your Mac\'s notch. TapDrop only looks at the screen at the moment a tap counts, then sends the real thing: the page, the original photo, video or file, or a screenshot. It goes straight to your own Mac over your Wi‑Fi, end‑to‑end encrypted, and nowhere else.
TapDrop — tap your Mac to send
